content: Yöb naa kà ilä a ntsüü isàkal anà an'taaŋ a mpay.
Ntɔn baar bàsàbulà aŋunguur, asam a ngim, aŋangaal anà aŋuyɔl, bàsatoo Nzam, aŋun'tswe ngwal akà aböör aba, baar mpa bàfàfuur an'tɔɔn, mpa abye anà inzaam,
aŋakɔɔrà, bàkɔ̈ɔ̈n ngyɛb, aŋankaabà, bàkɔ̈ɔ̈n nkääŋ a mpem, aŋankyɛl, ayiiŋ a yàŋàbwaŋ,
ayääl a baar, aŋakii, ikwàmii ntɔn uyɔl, asam a ilään a ndür, akwànaa asam a Nzam,
inzaam aba isàkal kyà nsà mpɛl, wɛɛ ba bàsàtɔn un'kanà a kya. Apɛ ngö baar aban.
Amwɛy uboo a ba bàfàbilà u ndwà a ndwà, waa bàfàkur akaar a mpem a bɔɔl bɔɔl, bàŋàyɔl a man'be, bàŋàkwɛlà unsà an'tɛy a ilään a ndür byà ifà ifà,
ba bàmulɔŋàkà taaŋ lanswà, wɛɛ ba bàfàkwo anki akà ikikye muyɔ̈b ndandaa.
Asànàa Yanɛs anà Yambrɛs bàmbäär ba Mɔsɛ, abun sye baar aban bàfàmbäär ba ndandaa, ntɔɔb aba yàŋàkalà, làkwikilà aba ngwal latɛy.
Wɛɛ ba bàsàkyà anki kwɛl, ntɔn unsil aba bàsàmɛnà akà baar banswà asànaa bàmɛnà unsil bàkäl akà baar abà bàbɔ̈ɔ̈l.
Wɛɛ akà ngye, ngye kàläb pànsi pànsi an'lɔɔŋ amɛ, nkääl amɛ, ntwaan amɛ, làkwikilà amɛ, nkääŋ a mpem amɛ, ukwen amɛ, muküünà amɛ,
nkwaaŋ amɛ, mpay yan'yeel u Antyɔsha, u Ikɔn, anà u Listre. Nkwaaŋ nà mpa kàkäŋ mɛ mpem! Unsà ya yanswà, Mwol kan'tsü mɔ̈ɔ̈.
Kyekà, baar bànswà bàfàkwen mukal unsà inzaam amu Klistɔ Yɛsu bàkyer asamɛɛy nkwaaŋ.
Wɛɛ akà baar abɛ anà aŋaloor, ba bàsàlalà unsà ube taaŋ lanswà, mukur baar bumwɛy anà ba ŋàkwo bàkyer asakur.
Wɛɛ ngye, tsim unsà indiir kàlɔŋàkà ngye anà kàkyey ngye naa bya byà ndandaa: ngye akyàyöb mbuur kalɔŋ bya.
Ngye akyàyöb Ndaa Aŋàsɔn yà In'kyɛɛl sɛmà imbɛy angye: ya ye anà ikɔ̈b mukapà an'yeerà ifàtwaal ngwɛɛl a mɔ̈ɔ̈ u mbwo a làkwikilà amu Klistɔ Yɛsu.
Un'kaan wanswà wàŋàsɔn u ngwal a Nzam we anà ndöŋ mulɔŋ, mutɔn, mulɔ̈ɔ̈n, muswaŋ mbwo a balàbal,
ntɔn mbuur a Nzam ukäl wàŋàkwo anà ukäl anà indiir mukyer isal aŋàbwaŋ.
